algorithm: HNSW uses a sparse hierarchy of proximity graphs. Greedy descent finds an entry point, then bounded best-first exploration at layer zero returns candidates. Insertion uses efConstruction and diversified neighbor selection. Reference: https://arxiv.org/abs/1603.09320 .
architecture: VectorService → HNSW nodes/layers → ANN search. Exact search is an independent distance-scan oracle. JSON persistence saves vectors, edges, levels and RNG state.
data_model: Unique string IDs map to fixed-dimension finite vectors. Layer adjacency is per node with degree limits M (upper) and 2M (base). Query = vector, k and ef >= k.
description: A hierarchical graph ANN index implemented from scratch with exact-search comparison, tombstones and checksummed persistence.
design: Use squared L2 throughout; results expose squared distance explicitly. Measure recall against an exhaustive scan. Workloads require at least .8 recall except duplicate vectors, where an exact-distance-radius gate accepts alternative tied neighbors. Keep tombstones traversable to preserve reachability.
family_notes: Index uniformly sampled vectors and compare nearest neighbors to brute force.
Test clustered embeddings and diverse neighbor selection.
Insert repeated vectors without reusing IDs.
Exclude tombstones from results while retaining graph navigation.
Round-trip graph and RNG state through checksummed JSON.
Vary vector dimension as well as collection size.
limitations: Python reference, not a million-vector production database. No embedding model, concurrency control, compressed vectors or live gRPC transport. proto schema is a design artifact only. Graph links may become asymmetric after per-node degree pruning. Deleted nodes remain in memory; rebuilding is needed for reclamation. Checksums are not authenticity signatures.
operations: Tune ef and M against actual data and query distributions. Maintain an exact sample for recall measurement. Keep persistence in a trusted private directory and review schema before remote ingestion.
scope: Random level assignment, greedy upper-layer navigation, ef-limited priority-queue search, neighbor diversification/pruning, insertion, deletion filtering, exact L2 baseline, persistence and an operation service class.
security: Treat this as educational code; review it before handling trusted data.
title: Vector Database with HNSW Indexing
